tiers.everyday: Mechelen in Belgium is a world centre of the carillon, a set of tuned bells played from a keyboard. St Rumbold's Tower holds two carillons and the city has a famous carillon school.
tiers.student: Visit Mechelen describes six carillons in the city, two in St Rumbold's Tower (one installed in 1981), and the carillon school founded by Jef Denyn in 1922. Belgian carillon culture was recognised by UNESCO in 2014 (per the city).
